steps.content: ...Fine, I'll crawl through this stupid pipe!

Hella desperately wishes that when she had shouted those words, the tiny doll could have given her a warning: She wasn't about to crawl through just a short ventilation duct, but the entire Furor Mountain!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huff... huff... Horo, I'm sorry... I'll never skip your training sessions again... Does... does this thing ever end......
The doll continues to hop forward dutifully, while deep in the darkness ahead, another faint speck of light appears.
As they move forward, the light grows brighter, and fragments of conversation begin to reach her ears.
[White transition] [Background: Hypatia's Room - Night]

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hmm! Well done, well done. I see you've got everything perfectly organized, my lady, from those DisCity outsiders to the institute's Aurum Secretum.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: With talents like yours, it's no wonder the higher-ups entrusted the entire institute to you.
It's that dangerous woman from Fraser again. Speaking insincerely with exaggerated gestures, Synex leans over to peer at Hypatia, who stands by the operation station.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh? What's this?
Hypatia is manipulating something on the bench. With each gesture of her hands, the metal begins to melt, flow, and combine into entirely new structures.
They shimmer with Aurum Secretum's distinctive luster, yet appear different from what Hella has seen before. They're more refined, more perfect.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Just a personal side project, that's all.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: They require minimal Aurum Secretum, yet can generate extensive protective formations. The strength issue of the first generation has already been solved. This new version has a shorter effective duration but vastly increased power. The protection it provides is already approaching that of Hypercube barriers.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: All this data was collected with help from both the townspeople and researchers. But...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Never mind. You probably wouldn't be interested anyway.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Let's get to the main issue, Synex. Has the family approved sending more staff to assist with the lab's evacuation?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hmm... What do you think?
The metal structure begins to stabilize. Hypatia sets down her experiment sample and calmly raises her head to meet Synex's disingenuous smile.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I don't see any issues with my proposal.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Of course, I'm not solely relying on the additional staff. The new Aurum Secretum barrier will last longer. Simply by using the same amount of Aurum Secretum as in the original plan, we can buy double the time for our researchers' evacuation.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Furorians aren't familiar with Aurum Secretum, so they wouldn't be particularly helpful even for transportation tasks. The lab has already begun the evacuation preparations, and we can manage the remaining equipment with our current staff.
Synex puts on an almost deliberately surprised expression, covering her mouth with theatrical exaggeration.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: My goodness, you're nearly done preparing already? Furor's guardian is always so dependable!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: But I'm afraid I must apologize, my lady. Despite all your hard work, well... plans rarely survive changing circumstances. You see, there's actually a slight modification to the evacuation plan...
A sense of foreboding washes over Hella, cold sweat breaking out across her back pressed against the stone wall. She hears the woman's soft, chilling laugh before the voice continues.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: The diplomatic mission has been moved up, and the delegation is understaffed. All those who were originally reserved for you have been reassigned. There's far too much valuable equipment in Furor for just the few remaining researchers to transport, so...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: The family has decided to continue with the previous plan, conscripting local residents as assistants who will remain in Furor to guard the Aurum Secretum until the recovery team arrives to retrieve them—<color=#fb9259>dead or alive</color>.

What does that mean? The Furorians have to stay until the Aurum Secretum is recovered... What about the damaged barrier outside? The Apostle? How are they supposed to protect themselves once the whole lab leaves?
Hella's thoughts race chaotically as she hears Hypatia speaking urgently outside.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The barrier's maintenance has already been suspended. It won't hold much longer, and the Apostle could return at any moment...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Exactly, time is of the essence, which is why we need everyone working together, right? The people of Furor are such good folks. The moment they heard they'd be helping Lady Hypatia, they agreed without a second thought!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But the residents here are just ordinary people. If they try to use Aurum Secretum to fight back...
The woman raises her index finger to her lips, casually silencing Hypatia's protests.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Miss Hypatia, they are to remain behind. This is the family's final say.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Don't forget our <color=#fb9259>mission</color>. Your research was never merely about protecting some small city nestled in the rocks. On the contrary, Furor was <color=#fb9259>built for Aurum Secretum and exists solely for it</color>.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: This is merely a necessary choice for our progress. It's natural that you pity and sympathize with them. But Aurum Secretum is the Campbell family's critical plan for revitalizing all of Outlands. Its development and protection are so demanding that it requires these people to stay behind, toiling like beasts of burden until they're expended...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Of course, your research here has already earned high praise within the family. As for those people staying behind... Well, they are equipped with Aurum Secretum, aren't they? Perhaps they'll survive somehow, don't you think?
She leans in close to Hypatia, her voice a hypnotic whisper.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Now is the time to put them to use. This is for the greater good, and as a Campbell, it should be your ultimate mission.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: We've come too far now. Can't let everyone's effort go to waste, can we?
Hypatia trembles from head to toe, her jaw clenched tight.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...The plan has never changed, has it?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: You never intended to spare Furor from the very beginning...
The masked woman steps forward and yanks up Hypatia's sleeve to expose her arm, revealing winding trails of corruption that spiral from her palm upward, leaving the entire limb scarred.
The same marks were seen on the Furorians who got backfired by Aurum Secretum while using the weapons.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: And what about you? You never told them the price of using Aurum Secretum either, did you?
Hypatia pulls back instantly. The woman releases her with a smirk, her tone growing more taunting.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: How beautiful. How hard must you have worked on this Aurum Secretum barrier? I bet you've barely gotten any sleep in ten days.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: What a shame they'll never know how much you've done for them, overworking yourself day and night... but all that work will now be mercilessly torn to shreds.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Aurum Secretum is such a great invention. It amplifies energy exponentially by resonating with it. Yes, there are some side effects, but from a strategic perspective, it far surpasses Hypercubes in value...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: How could something this valuable be wasted on protecting some tiny refugee shelter?
She picks up the recently adjusted Aurum Secretum from the bench. Its soft fluorescent blue glow becomes engulfed by the Mania in her palm, transforming into an ominous black-purple hue.
Hypatia's expression darkens instantly as she lunges forward to seize the Aurum Secretum from her hand.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Give it back! The barrier still needs to be adjusted!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: No, you no longer need it, not for the upcoming evacuation.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Stop... What are you doing...!
As she speaks, Synex opens her mouth and swallows the Aurum Secretum in her hand.
Mania surges through the room. The structure Hella is hiding behind creaks and groans, while the storm of Mania stings her eyes so much she can barely keep them open.

When the violent surge finally subsides, the room's furnishings lie in ruins, yet the two figures at its center still remain standing. The instigator appears completely unscathed, even licking her lips with lingering satisfaction.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Now, about our evacuation plan, you will cooperate, won't you?
Hypatia offers no response. Her head hangs low, and though her back remains straight, she looks so small and fragile, as if she might collapse at any moment.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Well then, consider yourself informed. Good night, my lady. Do get some rest.
Synex gives a knowing smile, then turns and walks away.

Silence finally returns to the room. Hypatia staggers forward, bracing herself against the bench with one hand. She takes several deep breaths, but ultimately crumples to the floor, trembling as she buries her face in the crook of her arm.
A noise breaks the silence. Someone jumps down from the overhead ventilation duct, meeting Hypatia's gaze as she looks up.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Hella?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Did you hear everything just now?
Hella presses her lips together, her expression tense.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You gonna say yes to her?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...I don't know.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Will you say no, then?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I don't know!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...No, you do know. You know perfectly well. You've known all along, but you still let the townspeople use the Aurum Secretum weapons!
The girl across from her averts her gaze, her voice barely audible.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Here in WhiteSands... one must pay a price to protect oneself. This applies to everyone.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ha, that sounds exactly like something a noble would say.
Hypatia looks up as if stung, her lips trembling, before finally bowing her head deeply.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...I'm sorry. I should have told you sooner.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: She's right. Furor was never just a shelter from the beginning. The Campbells funded this place, supplied it with resources, and ultimately turned it into a testing ground for Aurum Secretum.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: My research... it was supposed to protect Furor and all similar settlements across WhiteSands. But the Apostle keeps expanding its territory, and the barrier is already operating at maximum capacity. I can't find a way to improve it, and we're running out of time...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Please, Hella, trust me! I swear on the Campbell name, everything I've done has been for this city. I will get all of you out safely...!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But now, I've already... I'm sorry, please don't ask me any more questions...
Hypatia gently takes Hella's hand.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...When it's all over, I'll explain everything to you properly, okay?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So... this was all part of your plan from the beginning? Aurum Secretum, the Campbells, everything... There was never any real hope here...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Fine, if you want me to trust you, then tell me! Given everything you're capable of, if you just spoke up, everyone would believe you, so why...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why not tell everyone the truth yourself? Why do you need help from someone from DisCity?
Hella's questions completely stun Hypatia, leaving her frozen in place.
[Transition for 1 second, dialogue box shakes, alarm sounds, impact sound effect]
The ground beneath them shakes violently as the alarm warning of another attack on the barrier blares again.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is it the Apostle?! Crap, everyone in the city's in danger! We need to get down there...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Hypatia?
The girl remains frozen in place, head bowed, her voice so faint it's barely audible.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I... I can't show myself publicly. If my family found out, then the final plan would also...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...To hell with the Campbells! To hell with your family! It's all bullshit!
Something gets thrown down at Hypatia's feet, rolling several times before stopping in her sight. It's a small Aurum Secretum doll, the very object she had given Hella to guide her way.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The greater good? That's just a pretty excuse for using them! How can you even call yourself a noble... if you can't even protect your own people, but instead suck them dry and use them as human shields! You're just a bunch of cowardly parasites hiding behind others!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The Campbells... how are they any different from the DisCity mice they despise?!
Hella pauses, her voice nearly breaking.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Do you really think a noble's life is worth more than a commoner's?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I thought you truly cared about them, that you were different from the others... I was wrong.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Fine. If you won't save them, I will!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Hella! Wait!!
Hella turns away and rushes outside amid violent tremors.
